items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: Dexter Gordon refused to play that music. What did they do? Kicked Dexter--kicked Dexter Gordon out.

ctx.x: So we play--we playing all the music we heard. We learn how to play from the records--all the Charlie Parker, all the Dizzy Gillespie's, all the Dexter
Gordon--anything you'd name. Lester--Johnny Burdine, he was a Lester Young man, you know.
